title: Standalone command line options `--script` and `--main-loop` can't be used in export templates without a PCK
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable
- Reproducible in 4.5.dev (8f87e6030777f0cdd8216a8d23026e55e9358db4)
- Likely reproducible in earlier versions too

### System information

Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

Some standalone command line options like `--script` and `--main-loop` are exposed in export templates (not guarded with `TOOLS_ENABLED`) and show up in the `--help` output.

But they can't be used as is:
```
$ cat << EOF > main.gd
> extends MainLoop
> func _init():
>   print("hi")
>   return
> EOF
$ ./bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_debug.dev.x86_64 --script main.gd
Error: Couldn't load project data at path ".". Is the .pck file missing?
```

With a `project.godot` or PCK file passed with `--main-pack`, they become usable:
```
$ touch project.godot
$ ./bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_debug.dev.x86_64 --script main.gd
Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build.8f87e6030 (2025-06-09 07:42:26 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.305 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV PHOENIX)

ERROR: Could not load global script cache.
   at: get_global_class_list (core/config/project_settings.cpp:1327)
hi
```

The problem is that `--script` is handled in `Main::start()` and depends on `ProjectSettings::setup` having run.
ProjectSettings are initialized in `Main::setup()`, with a special case for the editor so it can work without a project:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8f87e6030777f0cdd8216a8d23026e55e9358db4/main/main.cpp#L1928-L1942

But export templates instead raise the above error about not having a PCK.

---

We could outright unexpose those standalone tools from export templates, but since they work when there is a project file, they might still have a use case. It might be possible to special case things in `Main::setup()` like we do for `TOOLS_ENABLED` if a standalone tool is used.

### Steps to reproduce

```
scons target=template_debug
cat << EOF > main.gd
> extends MainLoop
> func _init():
>   print("hi")
>   return
> EOF
./bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_debug.dev.x86_64 --script main.gd
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

n/a
